gitCommit.subject: feat: Add AI Insights generation functionality and related tests
gitCommit.body:
feat: Add AI Insights generation functionality and related tests

- Implemented GenerateAIInsightsPage class for handling AI insights generation.
- Created tests for AI Assistant interactions and insights generation.
- Added comprehensive tests for AI Dashboard KPI flow, including role switching and metric verification.
- Developed tests for generating AI insights across various metrics for different roles.
- Enhanced existing insights tests with improved error handling and retry logic.
